WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT
    sf.zoneref AS site_code,
    s.entrystat AS access_status,
    AVG(sf.traitcount) AS avg_traitcount,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM scanfeatures AS sf
  INNER JOIN sites AS s
    ON sf.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE sf.traitcount >= 489
  GROUP BY sf.zoneref, s.entrystat
)
SELECT
  site_code,
  access_status,
  avg_traitcount,
  record_count,
  record_count::double precision / NULLIF(SUM(record_count) OVER (), 0) AS fraction_of_total
FROM grouped
ORDER BY fraction_of_total DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
